verdict.rationale: Twenty documents CSV/XLSX/XLS import with column-to-field mapping, duplicate detection, and in-UI error fixing. Relations can be linked by unique fields, including workspace-member email, which lets record owners be mapped. An unlimited API import path with batch create/upsert supports large migrations. However, there is no evidence of a native migration connector from another CRM, and no evidence that activity history (notes, tasks, timeline, past changes) carries over. Imports are one object type per file, so migration is a manual multi-file or scripted process. Missing for 10: direct importers from other CRMs, documented migration of activity/timeline history, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a full CRM migration.
